capabilities: add personal annotations to installed plugins in the settings pane
format annotations with Markdown and Obsidian links
lock annotation fields and hide empty ones
store annotations in a Markdown file
show GitHub links to each plugin's repository
disambiguation: Not a note-annotation tool; it adds comments to installed plugins in the settings pane, not to notes in the vault.
extras: The Privacy section discloses that the plugin reads vault file names only for the optional 'Store annotations in a Markdown file' feature and makes one network request to raw.githubusercontent.com to fetch Obsidian's community plugin list for GitHub links, which can be disabled.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in place to record why a plugin is installed or what it is used for, so that context is easily forgotten.
summary: Adds persistent, Markdown-formatted personal annotations to each installed plugin in the Community plugins settings pane.
